trophies.guide: The platinum is not a task of its own — it lands the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. Work the eight getaway stops in order and it arrives at the end of Stop 7, after the cleanup. Keep the five unconfirmed-trigger trophies for last and check them before calling the run done.
trophies.how: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops on the last one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.text: Play the story and every side strand first — the platinum only tracks the other 54 trophies, not a task of its own. [1][3]
Watch the Progress tab climb toward 54/54; whichever trophy you earn last triggers the platinum at once. [3][4]
Leave the five trophies whose triggers are not yet confirmed for the cleanup stop and verify each one before finishing. [1][6]

trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy of the run and it cannot be missed. Play it through to the end and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Treat it as the on-ramp: from here the story opens up and the real planning starts.
trophies.how: Play Gone Fishing to the end.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.text: Start a new game and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from its first objective. [1][3]
Follow the mission objectives to the end — there is no optional branch to worry about here. [1][4]
The trophy pops when the mission completes; nothing in this mission can be missed. [3][4]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 in full and the trophy pops at its close. Chapter 1 is also where the run's one true missable lives: meditate at the early Chapter 1 spot the moment you see it, because that spot is gone for good once the chapter closes. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter — there is no mission replay.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 1 story mission.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1's story missions in order until the chapter closes. [1][3]
Meditate at the early Chapter 1 spot as soon as it appears — it is the run's only missable and it vanishes with the chapter. [1][2]
Keep a manual save from the start of the chapter; with no mission replay it is your only way back. [1][5]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 and the trophy pops at its close. From Chapter 2 both Jason and Lucia are playable, and most of the game's trophies start opening up from here — side strands, activities and collectibles all become fair game. Keep meditating at every spot you pass; the count runs to 18.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 2 story mission.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.text: Play Chapter 2's story missions through to the chapter's end. [1][3]
Note that both protagonists are playable from Chapter 2, which opens most of the trophy list. [1][5]
Meditate at any spot you pass in the chapter — the early Chapter 1 spot is already gone, so never walk past one. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops at its close. Chapter 3 is a deadline chapter: the Strangers & Freaks strand tied to the race against Yago closes here, so start every stranger strand the moment it appears instead of stockpiling them for later. Heist trophies also begin to open in Chapters 3 and 4.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 3 story mission.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.text: Play Chapter 3's story missions through to the chapter's end. [1][3]
Start every Strangers & Freaks strand as soon as it appears — the race-against-Yago strand closes mid-story in Chapter 3. [1][5]
Expect heist-related trophies to start opening in Chapters 3 and 4. [2][6]

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at its close. By now the story is nearly done and the free-roam cleanup is close — but do not rush past the chapter's optional content, because some of it feeds the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Make a manual save before the final mission.
trophies.how: Finish every Chapter 4 story mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.text: Play Chapter 4's story missions through to the chapter's end. [1][3]
Do the chapter's optional missions when they appear — some feed the 100% checklist and cannot be revisited. [1][5]
Make a manual save before the final mission; there is no mission replay and no New Game+. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission and this gold trophy pops at the credits. It is the last story trophy, and after it the whole of Leonida stays open in free roam — every collectible, activity and grind trophy can be finished after the story. Before you start it, make a manual save: there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back to the pre-finale state.
trophies.how: Finish the final mission (gold).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.text: Make a manual save before starting the final mission — no mission replay exists. [1][2]
Play the final mission through to the credits. [1][3]
After the credits, free roam stays open, so the remaining trophies can all be finished afterwards. [1][5]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run and the trophy pops when it ends. It is a named story mission, so it comes to you as the story advances — the only job is to not rush past the chapter's optional content on the way. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter as your safety net.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Breakfast Run.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.text: Reach Breakfast Run in the story and play it through to its end. [1][3]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [1][4]
Keep a chapter-start manual save — story missions cannot be replayed. [1][5]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist and the trophy pops when it ends. Heist missions are story beats, so this one arrives on its own as you play — no special preparation is needed beyond playing the story in order.
trophies.how: Finish the mission The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.text: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story and play it through to its end. [1][3]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [1][4]
Keep a chapter-start manual save — story missions cannot be replayed. [1][5]

trophies.where: Vice City — mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play and the trophy pops when it ends. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is earned by playing the story straight through — the guide's only honest advice is to do the optional missions that appear around it, because some feed the 100% checklist.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.text: Reach Child's Play in the story and play it through to its end. [1][3]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [1][4]
Do the optional missions that appear around it — some feed the 100% checklist. [1][5]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners and the trophy pops when it ends. It is a named story mission, so it arrives in order as you play — no grinding, no special route, just the story itself.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.text: Reach Headliners in the story and play it through to its end. [1][3]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [1][4]
Keep a chapter-start manual save — story missions cannot be replayed. [1][5]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown and the trophy pops when it ends. The airport setting is worth remembering for later: the separate trophy Catch Me If You Can is also about an unscheduled departure at VCIA, so keep the airport in mind once free roam opens.
trophies.how: Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.text: Reach VCIA Takedown in the story and play it through to its end. [1][3]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [1][4]
Remember the airport — the separate VCIA trophy comes later, in free roam. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory and the trophy pops when it ends. It is the last of the named-mission trophies, so by the time it pops you are deep into the story and the finale is close. Make your pre-finale manual save right after this stretch.
trophies.how: Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.text: Reach Operation Savage Glory in the story and play it through to its end. [1][3]
The trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. [1][4]
Make a manual save soon after — the final mission is close and there is no replay. [1][2]

trophies.where: Vice City — mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist itself only becomes visible after the story). The bar is forgiving: about 60% 'true completion' is enough, with partial credit on most categories, but a few items must be finished in full — robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. The time-sensitive part is the optional missions: they close as the story advances, so do optional content when it appears instead of leaving it for the end.
trophies.how: Reach 100% completion (gold) — forgiving bar, but optional missions close mid-story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.text: Do every optional mission when it appears — optional content that feeds the checklist closes as the story advances. [1][5]
Scan vehicles and study animals as you go; both count toward the checklist while you travel. [1][11]
Finish the must-complete items in full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. [1][5]

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — air time plus a clean landing is what counts. The efficient way is to find one safe jump with a clear landing zone and repeat it in free roam after the story, rather than chasing new jumps every time. Note the 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250 if you are chasing A Long Road too.
trophies.how: Repeat one safe jump in free roam; air time + clean landing counts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.text: Find a jump or ramp with a clear, flat landing zone in free roam. [1][2]
Repeat the same safe jump — air time plus a clean landing is what the counter wants. [1][5]
Keep going to 300 stunts if you also want the 100% checklist, which asks for more than the trophy. [1][2]

trophies.where: Statewide — anywhere with jumps, ramps and air.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — a sampler, not a grind. The quickest route is to work down the activity list in one free-roam session: each new type you try ticks the counter, and the trophy pops on the ninth. Use the counter stepper in this guide to tick them off as you try them.
trophies.how: Try all 9 activity types once, in one free-roam session.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.text: Open the activity list and pick a type you have not tried yet. [1][2]
Try one of each of the 9 types — one attempt each is enough, no score needed. [1][4]
Tick each type off on the stepper here as you try it; the trophy pops on the ninth type. [1][2]

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is the skill gate of the list: every range must be golded, and the ranges are also one of the must-complete items for the 100% checklist, so there is no skipping them. Practice one range at a time and use the stepper to track which of the 42 are gold.
trophies.how: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges, one range at a time.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.text: Visit a Shooting Range and work its challenges until each one is gold. [1][5]
Repeat range by range until all 42 challenges show gold. [1][2]
Remember the ranges are also a must-complete item for the 100% checklist — no skipping. [1][5]

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so this is a tour of the map rather than a single grind — win once per location and move on. Drone races are also a must-complete item for the 100% checklist.
trophies.how: Win one drone race at each of the 14 locations.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.text: Find a Top Fun drone race location and win the race there. [1][2]
Move to the next location and repeat — one win per location, 14 in total. [1][6]
Drone races are a must-complete item for the 100% checklist, so finish all of them. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same one twenty times. Mix race types as you travel so the counter climbs steadily, and use the stepper to track which count is already won. Races are all available in free roam after the story.
trophies.how: Win 20 different race courses.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.text: Enter a race you have not won yet and win it. [1][2]
Vary the courses — only different races count toward the 20. [1][5]
Track wins on the stepper here so you do not repeat a course by accident. [1][2]

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the side activities that opens up as you meet the state's characters — take the challenge when it appears and beat Cal at his own game. It is a one-off challenge, not a grind.
trophies.how: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.text: Take Cal's fishing challenge when it appears. [1][2]
Fish the challenge through and beat Cal's result. [1][6]
The trophy pops when you beat him — one challenge, no repeat needed. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any game, any arcade, one full playthrough. This is the lightest activity trophy on the list: walk into an arcade, play a game to its end, and the trophy pops. Do it while passing an arcade in free roam and it costs almost no time.
trophies.how: Play one arcade game to its end.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.text: Walk into any arcade in free roam. [1][3]
Start an arcade game and play it through to its end. [1][8]
The trophy pops when the game completes — one game is enough. [1][3]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission chain through to his final mission. Side-story contacts each have a final mission that pops its own trophy — play Andy's strand when it appears and see it through to the end. Side content stays available in free roam after the story, so there is no deadline on this one.
trophies.how: Finish Andy's final mission.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.text: Pick up Andy's missions when they appear and play the chain through. [1][2]
Finish his final mission — that is what the trophy tracks. [1][5]
Side strands stay open in free roam, so this can be finished after the story. [1][2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission chain through to his final mission. Like the other contact finals, this one is earned by playing the strand to its end — no extra objective hides behind it. Take it when it appears and see it through.
trophies.how: Finish Kenton's final mission.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.text: Pick up Kenton's missions when they appear and play the chain through. [1][2]
Finish his final mission — that is what the trophy tracks. [1][9]
Side strands stay open in free roam, so this can be finished after the story. [1][2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission chain through to his final mission — the Lone Rider strand. Play the chain when it appears and see it through to the end; the trophy pops on the final mission, not on the first meeting.
trophies.how: Finish Billy's final mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.text: Pick up Billy's missions when they appear and play the chain through. [1][2]
Finish his final mission — that is what the trophy tracks. [1][10]
Side strands stay open in free roam, so this can be finished after the story. [1][2]

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. This is one of the two time-sensitive trophies: the strand tied to the race against Yago closes mid-story in Chapter 3, so start every stranger strand the moment it appears instead of stockpiling them for later. The silver pops on the eighth strand.
trophies.how: Complete 8 stranger strands — start each the moment it appears; the Yago race strand closes in Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.text: Start every stranger strand the moment it appears — do not leave them for later. [1][5]
Finish the race-against-Yago strand before it closes in Chapter 3. [1][6]
Complete strands until the counter reaches 8 — the silver pops on the eighth. [1][5]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission chain through to his final mission. Play the strand when it appears and see it through to the end — the trophy pops on the final mission, and side content stays open in free roam after the story.
trophies.how: Finish Randy's final mission.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.text: Pick up Randy's missions when they appear and play the chain through. [1][2]
Finish his final mission — that is what the trophy tracks. [1][7]
Side strands stay open in free roam, so this can be finished after the story. [1][2]

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission chain through to his final mission. Play the strand when it appears and see it through to the end — the trophy pops on the final mission, not on the first meeting.
trophies.how: Finish Tyrone's final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.text: Pick up Tyrone's missions when they appear and play the chain through. [1][2]
Finish his final mission — that is what the trophy tracks. [1][11]
Side strands stay open in free roam, so this can be finished after the story. [1][2]

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, starting with one early spot in Chapter 1. That early spot is the run's one true missable: it disappears permanently when Chapter 1 closes, and there is no mission replay or New Game+ to get it back. The sources disagree on the early spot's exact place — PowerPyx puts it at Jason's house, while OutputLag and eGamers describe a balcony meditation early in Chapter 1 — so meditate at every early spot you find and do not trust a single address. They also disagree on the total: PowerPyx counts 18 spots, other lists count 15, so keep meditating until the trophy pops.
trophies.how: Meditate at every spot the moment you see one — the Chapter 1 spot never comes back.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.text: Meditate at the early Chapter 1 spot the moment you see it — it is gone for good once Chapter 1 closes. [1][2]
Work through the remaining spots across Leonida's 10 meditation locations until the count reaches 18. [1][5]
Sources disagree on the total — PowerPyx counts 18, other lists count 15 — so keep meditating until the trophy pops. [1][6]

trophies.where: Statewide — 18 spots in 10 locations, starting in Chapter 1.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunt is a side-story strand with its own target — track the animal, take it down, and the trophy pops. Bret's quests are also one of the must-complete items for the 100% checklist, so finish them properly rather than leaving the hunt half-done.
trophies.how: Hunt the unique animal for Bret.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.text: Take Bret's hunt when it appears and track the unique animal. [1][2]
Hunt the animal down and finish the hunt. [1][5]
Bret's quests are a must-complete item for the 100% checklist — finish the strand. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets — cards scattered across Leonida, gathered set by set. Work one set at a time and use the stepper to track completed sets; the silver pops on the third finished set. Cards are all collectible in free roam after the story, so there is no deadline.
trophies.how: Complete 3 card sets, one set at a time.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.text: Find cards across Leonida and gather them into sets. [1][2]
Complete one full set, then move to the next. [1][6]
The silver pops on the third completed set — track sets on the stepper here. [1][2]

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations across Leonida — a statewide tour, not a single spot. Work region by region so you do not lose track of where you have already been, and use the stepper to count locations as you go. Everything here is available in free roam after the story.
trophies.how: WAiNK It at 100 locations, region by region.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.text: Find a WAiNK It location and use it. [1][2]
Work region by region so no location is counted twice by mistake. [1][7]
Keep the stepper honest — the silver pops at 100 locations. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the small goals scattered through the game — finish them as you play and the counter climbs on its own. Note the 100% checklist counts 70 of 80 challenges and lets you skip the hardest ones, so the 50 for this trophy are the easy half of the same list.
trophies.how: Complete 50 challenges as you play.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.text: Take on challenges as you meet them in free roam. [1][3]
Finish 50 of them — the counter climbs as you play. [1][11]
Skip the hardest ones if you like; the trophy only needs 50. [1][3]

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. Build the wanted level with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until it clears. Do it in a quiet corner of the map where you can run without being boxed in.
trophies.how: Hit 4 stars with your partner, then break line of sight and escape.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.text: Get your partner in the car and build a 4-star wanted level together. [1][2]
Break line of sight and leave the search area. [1][5]
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears — the trophy pops on the escape. [1][2]

trophies.where: Port Gellhorn — open roads, with your partner.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. The trick is the chain, not the loot: keep the wanted level alive between robberies and move fast from shop to shop. Plan a route of three close shops before you start, and keep your partner with you for all three.
trophies.how: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.text: Plan a route of three close shops before you start. [1][2]
Rob the first shop with your partner, then move straight to the next — keep the wanted level alive between robberies. [1][6]
The trophy pops on the third robbery in the chain. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in, drive, and each new model ticks the counter. Scan vehicles as you travel during the story so the count is already high by free roam, then mop up the rest by driving anything you have not driven yet. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicles, so keep discovering past 100 if you are chasing A Long Road.
trophies.how: Drive 100 different vehicles; scan them as you travel.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.text: Drive any vehicle you have not driven before — each new model counts. [1][2]
Scan vehicles as you travel during the story so the count climbs early. [1][8]
Keep going to 200 vehicles if you also want the 100% checklist. [1][2]

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up rather than hoping for it: gather a group of enemies in one place, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends. A crowded fight with cover nearby is the reliable setup.
trophies.how: Group 5 enemies, trigger Combat Focus, drop all five in one use.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.text: Find a spot where five enemies gather in one place. [1][2]
Trigger Combat Focus with all five in range. [1][9]
Take down all five before the focus ends — the trophy pops on the fifth. [1][2]

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the airport. Get to the airport, find a way out by air that is not on any schedule, and leave. It is a one-off stunt-style trophy, so treat it like one: scout the airport first, then commit to the departure.
trophies.how: Leave VCIA by air, off-schedule.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.text: Get to VCIA airport in free roam. [1][2]
Find a way to depart by air that is not a scheduled flight. [1][10]
Make the departure — the trophy pops as you leave. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a wink, not a manual: get into a Rhino tank situation and handle it. Tanks show up at high wanted levels and around military areas, so this one comes naturally if you spend time at the top of the wanted scale.
trophies.how: Get into a Rhino tank situation and handle it.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.text: Raise your wanted level or head for a military area where Rhinos appear. [1][2]
Get into the tank situation the trophy describes. [1][6]
Handle it and the trophy pops — no counter, one moment. [1][2]

trophies.where: Mount Kalaga — high wanted levels, military areas.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth job, not a smash-and-grab. Case the store first, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again; the trophy only counts a clean run.
trophies.how: Case the store, rob it quietly, leave unseen.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.text: Case the jewelry store first and learn its layout. [1][2]
Rob it without being detected — quiet and quick. [1][5]
If you are spotted, leave and retry; only a clean run counts. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape — five separate jobs, each ending with a clean getaway. Plan each vault like the others: get in, take the vault, and escape before the response closes in. The silver pops on the fifth escape.
trophies.how: Rob 5 bank vaults, escaping cleanly each time.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.text: Pick a bank vault and plan the approach and the escape route. [1][5]
Rob the vault and escape cleanly. [1][7]
Repeat for five vaults — the silver pops on the fifth escape. [1][5]

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run their routes around the state — find one, hit it, and get away clean. One truck is enough; the trophy pops on the escape, not on the loot.
trophies.how: Hit an armored truck on its route and escape.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.text: Find an armored truck on its route around the state. [1][2]
Rob the truck. [1][11]
Escape cleanly — the trophy pops on the getaway. [1][2]

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. This is the map-completion trophy: drive, walk and fly into every named area until the map is filled in. Work region by region and watch the counter — the trophy pops on the 52nd area.
trophies.how: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida, region by region.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.text: Travel into every named area of Leonida — driving, walking and flying all count. [1][2]
Work region by region so no area is missed. [1][8]
The trophy pops on the 52nd area — track the count on the stepper. [1][2]

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — one per gang, nine in total. Each gang runs its own operations, so this is a tour of the state's underworld rather than a single heist. Use the stepper to tick off each gang as its operation is robbed.
trophies.how: Rob one illegal operation per gang — 9 gangs, 9 jobs.
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.text: Find an illegal operation run by a gang you have not robbed yet. [1][2]
Rob that gang's operation. [1][9]
Repeat for all 9 gangs — tick each one off on the stepper. [1][2]

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The name points at an early moment, so do it as early as you can — the watch flag on this trophy is the guide's honest caution, not a confirmed deadline. PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as not yet known, so this guide does not invent one: go to Ocean Beach, find the cocktail spot with the view, and enjoy it.
trophies.how: Go to Ocean Beach early and enjoy a cocktail with the view.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.text: Head to Ocean Beach as early in the game as you can. [1][6]
Find the cocktail spot with the view on the beach. [1][2]
Its trigger is listed as not yet known by PowerPyx — this guide does not invent one; enjoy the cocktail there. [1][6]
